finding.expected: Before Runtime FAILURE validation, bind failed_run to the existing canonical Run / RunTaskReference contract (or an existing equivalent validator) so the reference truth used by validate_runtime_failure_binding() is itself canonical. Add regression coverage where the same unsupported or mistyped executor is mirrored into both failed_run and FAILURE and prove compilation fails closed. Do not create a second RUN contract.
finding.issue: REPAIR_AUTHORING now reuses validate_runtime_failure_binding(), but the validator is anchored to executor/base identity taken from caller-supplied failed_run material that is not itself validated as a canonical Run. _run() accepts an unsupported executor value and _repair_authoring passes that same value as the expected executor. Therefore a malformed pair such as failed_run.executor="other" plus failure.executor="other" can satisfy the complete FAILURE binding even though no canonical Runtime RUN can carry that executor. The new regression only mutates failed_run.executor while leaving failure.executor unchanged, so it does not cover this mirrored malformed-material counterexample.

original_constraints: AIOS_DECISION_PACKET v1 remains one deterministic, read-only, provider-neutral envelope for exactly one selected semantic decision and supports exactly the existing six BP-3 flows: ARCHITECTURE, TASK_AUTHORING, SEMANTIC_REVIEW, REMEDIATION_AUTHORING, REPAIR_AUTHORING and DIAGNOSTIC. NONE, unknown flows, unknown payload kinds and packet nesting fail closed.

Keep canonical facts, bounded observations, Executor claims, prior semantic decisions and current Human input in distinct information classes. RESULT claims remain Executor claims; REVIEW/REMEDIATION/REPAIR remain prior semantic decisions; Human text cannot overwrite canonical subject/provenance/authority. The compiler creates no verdict, hypothesis, correction choice, Executor choice, lifecycle action, publication action or roadmap decision.

Do not modify files outside scope.modify. If satisfying this contract requires changing Unified State, Correction Frontier, Flow Resolver, transport/publication contracts, correction dispatch/approval authority, provider surfaces or frozen Kernel semantics, fail closed back to Brain rather than widening scope.
